_meta.description: Heart event #3 for npc_kiery: The Flinch

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [A loud crash outside. Kiery flinches violently]

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: I — sorry. I'm sorry. It's not — I'm fine.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Please don't... please don't raise your voice. I know you didn't—

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: It's not about you. It's never about you.

options.text: [Sit quietly. Don't move closer. Let her breathe.]

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: ...Thank you for not asking what's wrong.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Thank you for just... being still.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: Most people want an explanation. You just gave me space.

lines.speaker: npc_kiery
lines.text: I'll tell you someday. When I'm ready. Not today.
